desc: SD card is PHYSICALLY PRESENT as of 2026-08-02 (CJ). sdhci-pci binds mmc0 (ADMA 64-bit) but has never seen media. Test end to end: card detect, /proc/partitions shows mmcblk0[p1], mount, read, WRITE + fsync, reboot, re-verify persistence. Then wire into t6040-data-mount as a persistent /data target alongside NVMe (script already polls /dev/mmcblk0p1 -> /mnt/sd; t6040-data-sync already prefers /mnt/nvme then /mnt/sd). Fastest available path to the storage milestone since NVMe is blocked on the CQ wrap assert. Rig: claude.
